Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1111
Claimant:
Samuel Murphy
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
12/31/2024
Claim opened after the insured driver reported being struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant, who
has no legal representative, gave a brief account during the first call.
01/03/2025
The insured driver is listed on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
01/04/2025
The police report places the claimant in the other vehicle at the scene. No witnesses to the collision itself have come
forward, and no photographs or second report have been submitted.
03/13/2025
The damage to the claimant's vehicle lines up with the impact described, and no earlier damage to that vehicle
appears in the records.
04/01/2025
The claimant reports neck strain and was seen at a clinic shortly after the collision. The reported injury is plausible for
a crash of this type.
05/10/2025
The claimant has told the same account in every conversation so far, including the order of the turn and where the
vehicles made contact.
05/19/2025
Medical records show no earlier injury to the neck or upper back. Treatment has followed a usual course, with visits
tapering as symptoms eased.
06/15/2025
Apart from the police record placing the claimant at the scene, no independent source has been located that confirms
how the accident happened.
07/14/2025
Treatment has continued to taper as the claimant improves. The file remains open pending a final medical update
before the injury component is closed.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
